---
title: "Weekly forecasts"
output: html_document
params:
  forecast_date: ""
  hub_ref: "main"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Report of a forecast built only from the forecast parquet in
# output/cityforecasts/<forecast_date>/ and the hub data as of the forecast
# date, so it can be rendered from main without the targets store (e.g. for a
# forecast generated locally). Rendered by bin/render_forecast_report.sh.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(purrr)

forecast_date <- ymd(params$forecast_date)
weeks_to_show <- 13

forecast_file <- list.files(
  file.path("output", "cityforecasts", forecast_date),
  pattern = "-epiforecasts-dyngam\\.parquet$", full.names = TRUE
)
stopifnot(length(forecast_file) == 1)
forecasts <- arrow::read_parquet(forecast_file) |>
  filter(output_type == "sample")

hub_url <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reichlab/flu-metrocast/", params$hub_ref
)
locations <- readr::read_csv(
  paste0(hub_url, "/auxiliary-data/locations.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
# Observations as they were on the forecast date, i.e. the latest vintage on
# or before it, falling back to the earliest vintage for older forecasts
time_series <- readr::read_csv(
  paste0(hub_url, "/target-data/time-series.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
vintages <- unique(time_series$as_of)
as_of_date <- if (any(vintages <= forecast_date)) {
  max(vintages[vintages <= forecast_date])
} else {
  min(vintages)
}
observed <- time_series |>
  filter(
    as_of == as_of_date,
    target_end_date >= forecast_date - weeks(weeks_to_show)
  ) |>
  semi_join(distinct(forecasts, location, target),
    by = c("location", "target")
  )

# Median and 50% and 90% intervals of the samples
summaries <- forecasts |>
  group_by(location, target, target_end_date) |>
  summarise(
    median = median(value),
    lower_50 = quantile(value, 0.25),
    upper_50 = quantile(value, 0.75),
    lower_90 = quantile(value, 0.05),
    upper_90 = quantile(value, 0.95),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
location_states <- locations |>
  select(location, state) |>
  right_join(distinct(forecasts, location), by = "location") |>
  mutate(state = coalesce(state, "Other"))
```

Forecast date: `r forecast_date` |
Hub data as of: `r as_of_date` |
Locations forecast: `r n_distinct(forecasts$location)`

Black: observations as of the forecast date. Blue: forecast median with 50%
and 90% intervals.

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
plot_state <- function(state_name) {
  locs <- location_states$location[location_states$state == state_name]
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = filter(summaries, location %in% locs),
      aes(x = target_end_date, ymin = lower_90, ymax = upper_90),
      fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = filter(summaries, location %in% locs),
      aes(x = target_end_date, ymin = lower_50, ymax = upper_50),
      fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = filter(summaries, location %in% locs),
      aes(x = target_end_date, y = median),
      color = "steelblue"
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = filter(observed, location %in% locs),
      aes(x = target_end_date, y = observation)
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = filter(observed, location %in% locs),
      aes(x = target_end_date, y = observation),
      size = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = forecast_date, linetype = "dashed") +
    facet_wrap(~location, scales = "free_y") +
    xlab("") +
    ylab(paste(unique(forecasts$target), collapse = ", ")) +
    ggtitle(state_name) +
    theme_bw()
  print(p)
}

walk(sort(unique(location_states$state)), plot_state)
```
